title: Detector
text: Detect true duration on input and construct output true duration based on output type, 1 input, 1 output; {External reset} sets the whether the block can be reset, {Output type} specifies a fixed true duration length for the output Delayed fixed, {Time steps for input detection} sets the length of the true duration for input, {Time steps for delay} specifies the length of the delay duration and {Time steps for output durations} specifies the length of the output true. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input signal specified as boolean boolean

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output signal returns as boolean boolean

params.name: External reset
params.values: whether the block can be reset off (default) | on

params.name: Output type
params.values: specify a fixed true duration length for the output Delayed fixed duration (default) | Synchronized

params.name: Time steps for input detection
params.values: Length of the true duration for input detection 2 (default) | boolean

params.name: Time steps for delay
params.values: specify the length of the delay duration 1 (default) | boolean

params.name: Time steps for output durations
params.values: specify the length of the output true duration 3 (default) | boolean
